recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11697 unless a separate review of adjacent PlanDefinition action wording, such as FHIR-11698, is explicitly requested.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CDS change request FHIR-11697 asked to rename PlanDefinition.actionDefinition.concept to PlanDefinition.actionDefinition.code because comparable CodeableConcept elements on other resources use the element name code.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 10081, imported as git commit b1b06618efbf85fca01daa3a495ef7a410905abb, which changed the PlanDefinition element from concept to code and also made the parallel ActivityGroup/RequestGroup-family action element rename for consistency.
additional_context: Current source no longer uses actionDefinition or RequestGroup as the active names. source/fhir.ini lists PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration as active resources, and git commit 46bea37a00e63d1ace04a5f322614c6d0815f500 renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration under J#24619. Jira search surfaced adjacent FHIR-11698, but that is a separate PlanDefinition wording issue and was not required to decide this element-name reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already has PlanDefinition.action.code and RequestOrchestration.action.code, and source search found no remaining PlanDefinition.action.concept, RequestGroup.action.concept, RequestOrchestration.action.concept, or actionDefinition.concept paths.
